decisions.reason: It extends the firm's core geospatial integration business, was given a dedicated product page, and as a product line can be refined rather than withdrawn.
Digital-twin services fit the firm's direction toward enterprise-integrated geospatial solutions, but as a newer service mentioned only briefly they carry somewhat higher commercial uncertainty.

Authentication and identity delegation is strategically relevant for enterprise GIS deployments, though overlap with the firm's other identity offerings raises some chance of consolidation instead of standalone continuation.

An open GIS application development framework closely matches the firm's engineering and platform strengths and is the kind of foundational offer a German mid-sized specialist would typically nurture over time.

The identity and access service directly supports seamless integration of GeoIT applications and was explicitly launched on the website, suggesting clear strategic intent despite some portfolio overlap risk.
